title: Increase WebExtension manifest version on every extension change
summary: Every time a browser extension is changed, including during local iteration, increase its manifest.json version to a strictly higher valid extension version. This applies to code, resources and metadata revisions; do not confuse the extension version with manifest_version.

conditions: Every authorized script or extension modification, including local changes.
exceptions: Metadata changes do not independently authorize distribution.
